meta.note: Each case is a WAV file built from `recipe` (generate-audio.mjs wav). windows lists the 30 s windows: decodeWavForEmbedding, embedAudio with 30 s windows (at most 120; Kaan, 2026-11-14), then per window processor(null, null, window) and the model. tokenIds are the processor input_ids; embedding is the stored 256-value vector. Window 10k also holds electron: the vector Electron stores for its 300 s window k (its extractor keeps the first 30 s) and its cosine with embedding.
